style_when: scale is the story — a port, a refinery, a data centre hall, a rail yard, a skyline of cranes — and the reader needs to feel how big it is
prompt: Telephoto compression, 200mm long-lens view of a massive trucking freight terminal and highway interchange. Stacked overlapping layers of industrial structure receding into deep atmospheric haze. Endless rows of unbranded semi-truck trailers, loading docks, and concrete overpasses compressed together in a flat perspective. Overcast light, cool desaturated palette of steel grays, faded whites, and concrete. Immense industrial scale, calm editorial restraint, no people in the foreground, wide 16:9 framing.
negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, people, ui, signs, cartoons, bare shapes
rationale: The story is fundamentally about the massive scale of a $25 billion freight network. The telephoto compression visually communicates this immense physical scale and structure.
subject: overlapping layers of truck trailers and highway overpasses
alt_text: Compressed telephoto view of endless rows of truck trailers and highway overpasses receding into haze.
caption: The sheer scale of a consolidated freight network faces a market hesitant to lock in long-term volume.
title: Freight Network Scale
